candidates.angle: Emphasize a grotesque mismatch of scale: depict the market's safety device as microscopic next to an overwhelming flood or mountain of AI bonds to show impotence of the control.
candidates.title: 小さすぎる安全弁
candidates.scene: A tiny brass safety valve sits on top of a massive, teetering pyramid of identical bond certificates that towers over two tiny regulators standing beside the pile, each holding a wrench too small to affect anything. The pile spills slips like sand; the regulators strain but the valve is a pinhead compared with the volume.
candidates.reason: 安全弁の存在は示されているが、図ではその物理的規模が債券量に比べ圧倒的に小さく、制度の無力さを一目で伝える。
candidates.visualTurn: Scale shift: the control mechanism is tiny and ineffectual beside an enormous volume of issuance, making the presumed stabilizer visually unable to perform its role.
candidates.contradiction: The market's 'safety' is nominal: the device meant to control issuance is shown as far too small to affect the vast wave of AI bonds, contradicting confidence in its effectiveness.
candidates.evidence: 4. 高金利でも止まらぬAI起債、市場の「安全弁」揺らぐ－供給吸収に懸念（ブルームバーグ、AI関連等）2026/10/11

evaluation.reason: Scale inversion is the simplest, most directly grounded visual: a tiny safety valve beside a vast mountain of AI bonds communicates the valve's impotence relative to issuance clearly and cleanly. The composition is economical and will reproduce well at 64 mm. The idea is faithful to the headline and avoids inventing extra causal details, though it is a more conventional device than the other two.

candidates.headline: 4. 高金利でも止まらぬAI起債、市場の「安全弁」揺らぐ－供給吸収に懸念（ブルームバーグ、AI関連等）2026/10/11
candidates.angle: Make the quoted 'safety valve' into an object that behaves oppositely — instead of venting excess it devours or hoards bonds — to suggest the supposed absorber actually worsens supply concentration.
candidates.title: 安全弁が吸引機化
candidates.scene: A large industrial safety valve sits on a pedestal but its outlet is replaced by a huge vacuum hose. Issuers push trolleys piled high with fresh bond certificates straight into the hose, which noisily sucks them in. Around the valve, piles grow inside a transparent chamber while pressure gauges on the outside show rising strain.
candidates.reason: 「安全弁」という言葉の機能を逆転させ、放出して圧力を下げるはずの装置が逆に債券を吸い込み、吸収どころか集中や増加を可視化することで皮肉を示す。
candidates.visualTurn: Object inversion: the safety valve's expected function (release/relieve) is flipped — it operates like a vacuum that pulls in and accumulates newly issued bonds instead of releasing pressure.
candidates.contradiction: A ‘safety valve’ is pictured not as a stabilizer but as an active hoarder that intensifies the pile-up of AI bonds, contradicting the idea that the market has an effective absorber.
candidates.evidence: 4. 高金利でも止まらぬAI起債、市場の「安全弁」揺らぐ－供給吸収に懸念（ブルームバーグ、AI関連等）2026/10/11

evaluation.reason: Object inversion is clear and clever: the 'safety valve' behaving as a vacuum that hoards newly issued bonds directly contradicts the valve's expected stabilizing role. The composition can read well at small size if simplified, but the transparent chamber, trolleys and gauges add detail. The idea that the absorber actively worsens concentration is an interpretive step beyond the headline (which only says the safety valve is shaken), so grounding is slightly reduced.
unsupportedClaims: The market's 'safety valve' is actively operating as a hoover/vacuum that concentrates or increases bond accumulation (the headline reports concern about absorption but does not state the valve reverses function).

candidates.headline: 4. 高金利でも止まらぬAI起債、市場の「安全弁」揺らぐ－供給吸収に懸念（ブルームバーグ、AI関連等）2026/10/11
candidates.angle: Turn the dynamic into a literal role reversal: show new AI bonds leading and directing institutional investors, not the other way around, to underline how issuance persists despite deterrents.
candidates.title: 債券が投資家を先導
candidates.scene: A small, eager mechanical bond (a compact, dog‑like robot made of paper certificates) walks ahead, tugging a group of tall, suited institutional investors on leashes; they follow obediently. A factory conveyor behind them continuously spits out identical tiny bonds. A person at a large red emergency stop button slams it but the button is jammed and does not stop the belt.
candidates.reason: 本来は投資家や金利が供給を抑えるはずだが、図では“債券”の方が買い手を先導しているという逆転を見せ、市場力学の皮肉を直感的に示す。
candidates.visualTurn: Role reversal: instead of investors restraining issuance, the tiny AI bond literally leads and controls the investors on leashes; the usual leader/follower relationship is flipped.
candidates.contradiction: High interest rates and investor discipline are expected to slow issuance, yet investors are visually led by the new AI bonds—those who should restrain issuance are being pulled along by it.
candidates.evidence: 4. 高金利でも止まらぬAI起債、市場の「安全弁」揺らぐ－供給吸収に懸念（ブルームバーグ、AI関連等）2026/10/11

evaluation.reason: Strong, immediately readable role reversal: bonds on leashes leading suited investors is a vivid inversion of who should be in control. The jammed emergency stop adds a secondary ironic beat. However the scene packs many small props (tiny bond‑robot, leashes, conveyor, jammed button) that risk losing detail at 64 mm and it introduces a specific failed 'stop' action that the headline does not report, lowering grounding.
unsupportedClaims: A specific person attempted to stop issuance by slamming an emergency stop button and it was jammed (no such action is described in the supplied headline).
Investors are literally being led on leashes by bonds (this is a figurative inversion presented as a physical fact).

angleEvaluations.reason: Strong, immediately readable role reversal: bonds on leashes leading suited investors is a vivid inversion of who should be in control. The jammed emergency stop adds a secondary ironic beat. However the scene packs many small props (tiny bond‑robot, leashes, conveyor, jammed button) that risk losing detail at 64 mm and it introduces a specific failed 'stop' action that the headline does not report, lowering grounding.
unsupportedClaims: A specific person attempted to stop issuance by slamming an emergency stop button and it was jammed (no such action is described in the supplied headline).
Investors are literally being led on leashes by bonds (this is a figurative inversion presented as a physical fact).

angleEvaluations.reason: Object inversion is clear and clever: the 'safety valve' behaving as a vacuum that hoards newly issued bonds directly contradicts the valve's expected stabilizing role. The composition can read well at small size if simplified, but the transparent chamber, trolleys and gauges add detail. The idea that the absorber actively worsens concentration is an interpretive step beyond the headline (which only says the safety valve is shaken), so grounding is slightly reduced.
unsupportedClaims: The market's 'safety valve' is actively operating as a hoover/vacuum that concentrates or increases bond accumulation (the headline reports concern about absorption but does not state the valve reverses function).

angleEvaluations.reason: Scale inversion is the simplest, most directly grounded visual: a tiny safety valve beside a vast mountain of AI bonds communicates the valve's impotence relative to issuance clearly and cleanly. The composition is economical and will reproduce well at 64 mm. The idea is faithful to the headline and avoids inventing extra causal details, though it is a more conventional device than the other two.

prompt:
Create a single editorial cartoon for English-speaking newspaper readers.
News headline (source evidence, not lettering): 4. 高金利でも止まらぬAI起債、市場の「安全弁」揺らぐ－供給吸収に懸念（ブルームバーグ、AI関連等）2026/10/11
Satirical angle: Emphasize a grotesque mismatch of scale: depict the market's safety device as microscopic next to an overwhelming flood or mountain of AI bonds to show impotence of the control.
Scene: A tiny brass safety valve sits on top of a massive, teetering pyramid of identical bond certificates that towers over two tiny regulators standing beside the pile, each holding a wrench too small to affect anything. The pile spills slips like sand; the regulators strain but the valve is a pinhead compared with the volume.
Visual turn to show in the drawing: Scale shift: the control mechanism is tiny and ineffectual beside an enormous volume of issuance, making the presumed stabilizer visually unable to perform its role.
Depict this visible ironic reversal, not a literal reenactment of the reported event or a generic portrait. The turn must read without the title. A metaphor must not assert an unreported action or guilt.
Deliver the illustration alone. The page layout adds its title separately as real text. Do not render any title, subtitle, caption, heading or footer anywhere in this image, including the white margins. Do not write any Japanese characters in the image. Do not add text beneath the figures.
Strongly reference the pen-and-ink editorial cartoon work of Georges Bigot, Charles Wirgman and Charles Keene: observant human caricature, expressive faces and gestures, lively economical contours with deliberate changes in line weight, convincing clothing folds, and sparse hand-drawn hatching. Make these nineteenth-century draughtsmen the primary visual references throughout the drawing.
Create the original artwork for a newspaper illustration that will be printed using letterpress equipment and techniques from 150 years ago, circa 1876. Draw a deliberately composed, human-looking pen-and-ink original for an engraver to turn into a relief printing block. Use economical, clearly separated lines that remain legible when printed at small column size. Deliver the clean original drawing, without simulated aged-paper or printed-ink texture. Specific recognizable characters, expressive caricature, one clear visual joke, spare composition, natural asymmetry, varied purposeful contour lines. Avoid generic AI illustration conventions, glossy perfection, decorative clutter, stock robot imagery unless the joke specifically needs it, and irrelevant objects.
Black ink strokes on pure white paper ONLY. Clear outlines; express every shadow with sparse hatching, cross-hatching or stippled marks. Leave white paper visible between strokes. No gray fills, gradients, smooth shading, color, digital painting, photorealism, artificial paper texture or engraving filter effect. Keep most areas unshaded. Compact square composition, width:height exactly 1:1, complete subjects within the frame.
Design for a small newspaper column only about 64 mm wide. Use one clear visual joke with no more than two main figures and one essential prop. Remove secondary people, inset maps, small labels and ornamental detail. Render NO letters, numbers, symbols that resemble writing, speech bubbles, signs, stamps or pseudo-text anywhere in the image. Ignore ALL label or written-word instructions implicit in the headline, angle and scene except the one specified text element above. Never use fine print or tiny characters. Do NOT draw the Japanese title, a caption, a border, watermark or signature inside the image; the title will be typeset separately outside the artwork. Treat the scene as satire, and do not invent additional factual allegations beyond the supplied headline.
